September 25, 2018
7:30
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R18-43
NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 18-735
CALL TO ORDER (7:30 PM)
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
MAYOR’S REPORT – MATTERS OF COMMUNITY INTEREST
i.
Introduction & Presentation of the Parkland Rangers
ii.
Graduation Ceremony and City Council Recognition of Citizens Academy Class of 2018
CONSENT AGENDA (ITEMS 1 - 12)
All items under this heading are considered to be routine and will be enacted by one motion, unless a Councilmember or staff requests that an item be removed for separate discussion. Any item removed from the Consent Agenda will be considered immediately following the motion to approve the Consent Agenda. An applicant or interested citizen who wishes to appeal any Planning Commission decision (Items #11a-b) may file an appeal with the City Clerk's office within 15 days after the date of the Planning Commission's decision.
PUBLIC COMMENTS FOR ITEMS ON CONSENT AGENDA
Speakers shall be provided up to 3 minutes to speak regarding all topics on the Consent Agenda.
1.
Waive Further Reading
Recommendation: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first reading or adoption on second reading.
2.
Draft City Council Action Minutes - July 10, 2018
Recommendation: Review and Approve.
Minutes
3.
Demands of September 25, 2018
Recommendation: Approve payment of Motions #1 and #2.
a.
Motion #1 – Payroll Warrant of September 21, 2018
b.
Motion #2 – Warrant Register of September 25, 2018
Demands
4.
Monthly Investment Transaction Report - July 31, 2018 and August 31, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
Staff Report
5.
Transfer Balance of Stable Fund (50) to General Fund (01) and Account for Future Revenues as Concession Revenue in the General Fund (01)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve the internal accounting transfer of the Stable Operating Fund (50) and the Stable Capital Fund (80) to the General Fund (01).
Staff Report
6.
PW 652-18; Completion of Construction Contract for the FY17/18 Miscellaneous Street Repairs and Filing of Notice of Completion
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council accept as complete construction contract PW 652-18 for the FY17/18 Miscellaneous Street Repairs in the amount of $377,502.88 and direct the City Clerk’s office to file the Notice of Completion, and release the 5% retention 30 days after the County Recorder's office records the Notice of Completion, if no stop notices are filed.
Staff Report
7.
Acceptance of Donations
Recommendation: Accept the gifts as presented.
Staff Report
8.
Adoption of Resolution R18-41 Appropriating the Expenditure of Citizen’s Options for Public Safety (COPS) Funds and Approval of Awarding Disaster Preparedness Professional Services Agreement
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council adopt R18-41 appropriating the expenditure of $95,000 of COPS funds, and approve a professional services agreement with Emergency Planning Consultants.
Staff Report
9.
Consideration of Letter in Support of the Green Line Extension along the Right-of-Way or Hawthorne Boulevard
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council support the Green Line Extension for a route along the former Harbor Subdivision freight rail line that runs from downtown LA to Aviation Blvd near LAX then through El Segundo to the Galleria Shopping Center then southeast past Crenshaw Blvd. in Torrance to the Port of LA. right-of-way or Hawthorne Boulevard and accordingly, direct a letter to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority Board.
Staff Report
10.
Consideration of Parklands Committee Recommendations of September 13, 2018
Recommendation: Review and approve.
a.
PC-514-18; Application to remove 1 Canary Island Date palm tree located in the Parklands adjacent to 2840 Via De La Guerra
Applicant: Edward and Alanna Kennedy
2813 Via Rivera
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Action: Recommended to the City Council denial of PC-514-18. (3-0-1 in favor, McCabe absent and Leach recused).
b.
Conceptual Landscape Design for the triangle and center medians at the Palos Verdes Drive West and Palos Verdes Drive North intersection.
Action: Present to the City Council as Option 1 (first choice) the plan by Richie-Bray, Inc. and staff, and as Option 2 (second choice) ‘Team 2’s’ 9/11 Memorial plan. The Committee also added the proviso that if City Council approves Option 2, that the flag poles be upgraded from the present plastic pipes. (4-0-1 in favor, McCabe absent).
c.
Proposition 68-California River parkways Grant Program
Action: Recommended approval to the City Council to apply for the Grant available from Proposition 68. (4-0-1 in favor, McCabe absent).
Staff Report
11.
Planning Commission Actions of August 21, 2018
Recommendation: Receive and File.
a.
NC-1626-18; Consideration of a Neighborhood Compatibility Application for additions & remodeling at the single family residence located at 1509 Espinosa Circle. Lot 20, Block 1376, Tract 6889. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant/
Owner: Mark Payne
Action: Approved (3-1-1 in favor, Thomas dissenting & Lazarro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Any nonstandard encroachment within the City right-of-way, including, but not limited to the walls, shall be removed and replaced with standard curb and gutter per the City Engineer; 2) South-facing windows on the second floor shall be fogged; 3) Northern pepper tree to be removed, subject to PVHA approval; 4) Southern pine tree and pepper tree to be thinned; 5) roof pitch shall be modified to a 2:12 slope; and 6) ground level plate height shall be 9' 6".
b.
NC-1624/G-1617/M-1258-18; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for additions & remodeling to the single family residence and walls exceeding the allowable height located at 421 Via Media. Lots 12 & 13, Block 1511, Tract 6886. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Pritzkat & Johnson Architects, Inc.
306 Vista Del Mar, Suite A
Redondo Beach, CA 90277
Owner: Welch Trust
Action: Approved (4-0-1 in favor, Lazarro absent) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The elevations of the driveway approaches shall be plotted with the proposed design elevations based on City standards to verify that vehicles can maneuver grades, and street flood control capacity is maintained; 2) Reconstruct/repave portions of alley in public R/W adjacent to rear driveway based on limits as determined by the City Engineer; 3) Per LID guidelines, the following measures shall be implemented for the design and construction of the project: a) Divert roof runoff and surface flow to vegetated areas before discharge unless the diversion would result in slope instability; and b) Direct surface flow to vegetated areas before discharge; and 4) all future vegetation shall be limited to the ridge height of the primary structure.
Staff Report
12.
Considerations of the Finance Advisory Committee Actions and Activities Determined at its Meeting on September 6, 2018 and Approval of Resolution R18-42 Appropriating $3,100 for Videotaping of Monthly Finance Advisory Committee Meetings
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the actions and direction of the Finance Advisory Committee from its September 6, 2018 meeting for approval and Resolution R18-42 for the appropriation of $3,100.
Staff Report
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
PUBLIC HEARINGS/ORDINANCE(S)
All persons addressing the City Council during public hearings shall be limited to three (3) minutes for comment, except for an Appellant/Applicant, which shall be provided five (5) minutes for presentation and rebuttal.
13.
Two Requests to Appeal Planning Commission Approval of CDP-113-18; Consideration of a Coastal Development Permit for a New Wrought Iron Fence Within the Coastal Zone Located at 2801 Via Segovia. Lot 1, Tract 23062. (This Project is Exempt from CEQA per California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.)
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council open the public hearings for each appeal request, receive public input, close the public hearings, and make a decision on the application.
Staff Report
14.
Reintroduction on First Reading of Ordinance No. 18-734; an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Palos Verdes Estates, Amending Sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to Define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to Establish Procedures and Standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family Residential Zones.
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council reintroduce upon first reading Ordinance No. 18-734 amending sections 17.08, 18.04.130 and 18.08.010 of the Municipal Code to define Accessory Dwelling Unit and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit, to establish procedures and standards for Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units in the R-1 Single-Family Residential and R-M Multiple Family residential zones.
Staff Report
OLD BUSINESS
15.
Exchange of SCE Rule 20A Credits to the City of Rolling Hills in Exchange for General Fund Revenue
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an MOU with the City of Rolling Hills, subject to the approval of the City Attorney, for the exchange of the entire amount of the City of Palos Verdes Estates’ Rule 20A credits to the City of Rolling Hills, at a discounted rate of $0.60 totaling $600,000 in unencumbered General Fund revenue, and submit a credit transfer authorization letter to SCE.
Staff Report
16.
Discussion and Direction for Paseo Del Sol Turn Around
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council discuss available options for consideration of the project.
Staff Report
NEW BUSINESS
17.
Consideration of Options for Maintaining the Mirlo Gate Tower House at 2240 Via Valmonte
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council consider the options for maintaining the Mirlo Gate Tower House located at 2240 Via Valmonte and provide direction to staff.
Staff Report
18.
Consideration of Extension for Agreement for Refuse and Recycling Collection, Transportation, Processing, and Disposal Services Between the City and Arakelian Enterprises, Inc. Dba Athens Services
Recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council approve a 3-year extension of the current agreement and terms and direct the City Manager to prepare and execute a contract amendment for the 3-year extension.
Staff Report
STAFF REPORTS
19.
City Manager's Report
MAYOR & CITY COUNCILMEMBERS' REPORTS
20.
Ad Hoc Committee Reports
ADJOURNMENT TO TUESDAY, OCTOBER 9, 2018, AT 7:30 P.M. IN THE CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS FOR THE PURPOSE OF A REGULAR MEETING.
i.
This City Council meeting can be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City Website at www.pvestates.org.
